name: Ammunition
description: Requires ammunition to make a ranged attack. Drawing the ammunition is part of the attack; recover half of expended ammunition after a fight.

name: Finesse
description: When attacking, choose either Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls — use the same modifier for both.

name: Heavy
description: Small creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls with Heavy weapons because of their size and bulk.

name: Light
description: Lighter weapons enable two-weapon fighting — when you take the Attack action with a Light weapon, you can use a Bonus Action to attack with another Light weapon in your other hand.

name: Loading
description: You can fire only one piece of ammunition per Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction with a Loading weapon, regardless of how many attacks you can normally make.

name: Range
description: Listed as 'normal/long' in feet — attack rolls beyond normal range are made with disadvantage; attacks past long range automatically miss.

name: Reach
description: Adds 5 feet to your reach when you attack and when you make opportunity attacks with this weapon.

name: Thrown
description: You can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack at the listed range. Use the same modifier as for a melee attack with that weapon.

name: Two-Handed
description: Requires two hands when you attack with it.

name: Versatile
description: Can be used with one or two hands. The damage value in parentheses applies when wielded with two hands to make a melee attack.

name: Special
description: The weapon has unique rules; consult the weapon's individual entry for details.
